a11y_notes: Every interactive component (Ctrl, DeskButton, FilterChip, DeskSegmented, Tabs, Drawer) ships a vitest-axe assertion via the preconfigured @/shared/test/axe helper. Ctrl+Lbl wired via htmlFor/id; error caption uses role=alert + aria-describedby (aria-invalid on error). Tabs uses role=tablist/tab + aria-selected + arrow-key nav (wrapping) + roving tabIndex. Drawer is role=dialog aria-modal with focus trap, Escape-to-close, scrim click close, and focus restore to trigger.
deviations: Drawer intentionally DIVERGES from the mobile BottomSheet it was modelled on: BottomSheet is non-modal with no focus trap / no scrim (to keep the map logo reachable). The board Drawer is a true modal — added focus trap (Tab/Shift+Tab wrap), a --scrim overlay, createPortal to document.body, and aria-modal=true. Accessible name comes from the required title prop; closeLabel prop supplies the close button aria-label. No i18n imported inside any desk component (screens wire useTranslation).

Stat delta renders the new arrow-up/arrow-down Icon glyphs (colored via --success/--danger) rather than literal unicode arrows, honoring the icon set's no-unicode rule. A 'flat' delta renders no arrow (ink-2 tone).
PanelHeader title, DeskPill and Table th are uppercased with CSS text-transform only — the DOM/accessible text stays exactly as passed (guarded by a Panel test and a DeskPill test).
Ctrl supports text input and select via an `as` prop ('input' | 'select'); select-only native attrs pass through a `selectProps` object to keep the union typing clean.
Table exposes a composable primitive API (Table/Thead/Tbody/Tr/Th/Td) with a `$num` transient prop on Th/Td for right-aligned tabular-nums columns.
